semantic.justification: S3HW1E definition-list and nested-style checkpoint: native DL/DT/DD transitions consume the existing HTML contexts and unsigned definition depth, preserve implicit-list EndPara cleanup, mixed numbered-list spacing, current-DD-sensitive nested margins and explicit close behavior. Original HTML_DD/HTML_DT IDs12291/12292 are materialized as internal List Contents/List Heading collections with direct567/0twip left items, Standard parents and DT-to-DD follow identity; public available-style admission is unchanged. Original SetTextCollAttrs now retains displaced direct styles through owned hard item sets, Differentiate, PRE priority, nearest fallback context and native DD-minus-DT/DT-zero margin arithmetic. Shared GetAttrTabEntry/InsertParaAttrs use real registered Which IDs and original heads; InsertAttrs no longer maintains an incomplete duplicate map. Empty-paragraph script attribute loss and unsigned margin wrap are retained (WRITER292/293). Tests use real HTML/Markdown/documents/Worker and original public parser operations; no private-state or operation-result forging. Generated CSS class derivation, target insertion snapshots, stylesheet composition, raw HTML tables and full native reader ABI remain unverified or pending. No intentional browser file UI/autosave/recovery changes or full-goal promotion. S3HW1E HTML31: Original NewPara retains the whole nonempty CLASS string in a COLL_TEXT context; classless P remains default-only. SetTextCollAttrs delegates paragraph resolution to the actual SwCSS1Parser.GetTextFormatColl owner for each context and top-context margin set; fallback resolution uses GetTextCollFromPool. Consumed existing-document lookup retains script suffix stripping, ASCII-insensitive sdfootnote/sdendnote pool selection only for COLL_TEXT, USER_FMT-to-Standard fallback, exact existing named descendant identity and table-to-TextBody named fallback. Original lcl_swcss1_setEncoding changes direct non-symbol fonts only, preserving all other font fields and not materializing inherited fonts. The production Markdown HTML caller uses existing-document mode, where pinned StyleParsed exits before creating class/ID/tag rules. New-document stylesheet/class-map derivation, border/page-break CSS producers, target insertion snapshots, HTML tables and broad module/ABI parity remain unverified or pending; their presence in earlier historical lists is not automatic proof of a critical Markdown dependency. Real HTML/Markdown/Worker cases exercise actual owners without private state or provider/result substitution. NewHeading also retains the original CLASS on its actual context (swhtml.cxx:4113-4170); the fresh heading-owner regression exposed and closes the previously missing producer.
